references.text: Earlier in the same chapter it is mentioned that all male descendants of Aaron shall eat from the grain offering, and it is called most holy.
The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, and it is described as most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.
What remains of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.
All male priests shall eat the guilt offering; it is most holy.
It concerns which of the priests may eat from the holy gifts, both the most holy and the holy.
It describes that the most holy part of the fire offerings belongs to the priests, and that all males shall eat it in a holy place.
